description: Prövningsgrupper för vattenkraftverk is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Havs- och Vattenmyndigheten. The data contains the geographical demarcation of review teams for hydropower plants according to the national plan for review. The Annex to the Ordinance (1998:1388) on water activities sets out the names of the test groups and the date by which the application must be submitted. Coverage: Havs- och Vattenmyndigheten. The portal shows the English title as "Examination groups for hydropower plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Havs- och Vattenmyndigheten. Its keywords include Inspire, HVD. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, ZIP, HTML. The listing shows 2025-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
